WHAT THE PILOT SHOWS: welding appears in permits mainly where it is a listed emission unit or claimed PBR (Title V and NSR sites; metal fabrication NESHAP XXXXXX sources). Ohio PTIOs list only units that needed a permit (cutters, coating, ovens, engines), so welding was absent at all 5 Ohio sites. 'No permit found' and 'not named' are not evidence of no welding. Several hits are old (2003, 2009).

TIMING: once the tooling worked, a typical lookup took about 3-6 minutes per plant (TX: Central Registry address search by curl ~10 s, Records Online list ~5 s, downloading 7-77 documents 2-45 s, then reading; WI: facility search plus document-ID harvest ~2 min per permit, downloads seconds; OH: eDocs search ~30 s per attempt, about half rejected by the WAF, documents fetch in seconds). Working out each state's site mechanics took about 1.5 hours in total and is reusable via the scratchpad scripts.

Tool change: tools/fetch_page.py now treats a response whose body starts with %PDF- as a PDF (WI DNR serves permits as application/octet-stream); one-line change in plain(); needed for quote checks on apps.dnr.wi.gov documents. tools/__pycache__/fetch_page.cpython-313.pyc changed with it.
source_failures: TCEQ Central Registry (www15.tceq.texas.gov/crpub) and NSR permit search (www2.tceq.texas.gov/airperm) return 401 to headless Chromium and to python-requests with a browser UA; plain curl POSTs work (submit field name must be sent as _fuseaction%3Dregent.validateRE).

TCEQ Records Online: the search form needs JavaScript; the GET form with QueryText (xRefNumTxt <substring> RN...) works with plain requests and returns stable TCEQ_EXTERNAL_SEARCH_GET_FILE links. Some PDFs are scans with no text layer (e.g. Race Rock PBR application dID 6287081, Sabre 4720115) and were not read.

Ohio EPA eDocs (edocpub.epa.ohio.gov): plain HTTP gets a bot challenge; headless Chromium loads it, but the search postback is rejected by the WAF ('The requested URL was rejected') on roughly half of attempts; ViewDocument.aspx?docid= links fetch with plain requests.

WI DNR WARP permit search: document links only appear after selecting the permit and then the document row; AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id= links are then stable and fetch with plain requests. Emissions-inventory downloads are postbacks with no stable URL.
